How matches are played

RSL matches are played in Ragdoll Soccer, the original game on Roblox, and only on the EU host. The two managers decide whether a match is 8v8 or 4v4.

Match times are agreed between the managers and their assistant managers.

If a match ends in a draw and isn’t a cup match, there is no extra time. In a cup match, a draw goes to extra time.

Penalties are taken MLS style, one player against the goalkeeper, with no skills allowed. The last attack of a match is called the LA: once the team loses possession, the match ends.

Rules

In-game rules

Match verification
To play a match you must be signed. Playing unsigned results in sanctions and suspensions.
Signing mid game
You cannot sign mid game.
Scripting
Scripting results in a season ban.

Match regulations

Tackling
You cannot tackle a player who isn’t on the ball. It is an immediate free kick or a penalty, depending on where the foul was. A player gets one warning, then a yellow card if they do it again. Doing it three times is a red card.
Forfeits and mercy rule
Each team has 15 minutes to get their players. If the other team is offline or doesn’t get their players, the online team gets an automatic win. The mercy rule is 8: a team leading by 8 goals wins automatically and the match ends 8-0.
Emergency signings
A team that wants to sign a player an hour before the game can sign exactly 1 player. No more, no less, or the opposing side gets a +1 goal.
Kickoffs
The referee decides which team takes the kickoff. If the opposing team takes it, the kickoff is retaken and the player who took it gets a red card.
Alting
Alting is not allowed. If we catch you doing it, you are sanctioned.
Loans
Loaning or signing a player and then releasing them after a match is not allowed.
